title: WenshuGateReport
description: Version 1.0.0 PoC-A summary gate report (PA-12). Aggregates the real outputs of the full check family (P0: PA-07; P1: PA-08/09/10/11B) over the normal sample plus 12 fault samples: per-sample findings/manualChecks (location + numeric basis only, never document content), threshold evaluation (P0 detection rate, detected faults / 12, normal-sample false positives counted from real findings only), pass/fail verdict, exemptions with reasons (P0 rules can never be exempted), and the manual checklist carrying PA-A7/J1/K1/L1~L4/M1~M5/N1/N2. manualChecks are listed for human review but are never counted as automatic detections. Thresholds are pinned as schema constants so lowering them requires a contract version bump.

executedRules.description: Rule ids actually executed for every sample: the full P0+P1 registry minus rules absent via declared exemptions. Skipping a rule without a declared exemption violates the semantic contract.

exemptions.description: Declared per-rule exemptions (P1 only, each with a recorded reason). A P0 exemption attempt is rejected by the gate and can never appear here.

manualChecklist.description: Manual checklist carrying the audit followups PA-A7/J1/K1/L1~L4/M1~M5/N1/N2 item by item. Listed for human review; never merged into automatic detection counts.

baselineSha256.description: SHA-256 of the PA-05 signed baseline PDF the normal sample and all fault derivations anchor to.

faultSampleCount.description: Pinned fault sample count (roadmap PA-12). Changing it requires a contract version bump.

minDetectedFaults.description: Pinned minimum P0+P1 fault samples that must be detected (of 12), counting real findings only.

maxNormalFalsePositives.description: Pinned maximum findings tolerated on the normal (signed baseline) sample, honestly counted.

summary.description: Static sample description. Never document content.

falsePositives.description: Honest count of findings on the normal sample (semantically equals findings.length; nothing may be hidden or reclassified).

severity.description: Severity of the injected real defect. P0 faults must all be detected; a P0 miss fails the gate and cannot be exempted away.

domain.description: Rule id of the domain the injected defect belongs to.

summary.description: Static description of the injected defect. Never document content.

expectedCodes.description: Finding codes the injected defect must produce. Detection is judged against findings only; manualChecks never count.

evidenceSha256.description: SHA-256 of the baseline PDF the fault was deterministically derived from (in-memory derivation; frozen artifacts untouched).

detected.description: True iff every expected code appears in findings (semantically recomputed; manualChecks presence never satisfies detection).

faultSampleCount.description: Actual number of fault samples in this run.

detectedFaults.description: Fault samples whose every expected code appears in real findings. manualChecks are never counted.

p0DetectionRate.description: p0DetectedFaults / p0FaultSampleCount (1 when no P0 sample exists). Must be 1 for the gate to pass.

normalFalsePositives.description: Sum of findings over all normal samples, honestly counted.

failureCodes.description: Stable failure codes; verdict is pass iff this list is empty.

ruleId.description: Exempted P1 rule id (expressed as absence from executedRules). P0 rule ids are rejected by the gate and forbidden here.

reason.description: Recorded reason for the exemption. Static text only.

disposition.description: carried: truly carried by this report; registered: recorded in the risk register/manual list; closed: already closed with evidence; external: owned outside this gate.

summary.description: Static carry-over statement. Never document content.

reference.description: Authoritative doc path for the followup (ledger/audit report/decision).

relatedCount.description: Dynamic count when the item pins a real quantity (e.g. manualChecks total for PA-J1/PA-M1/PA-N2).

reason.description: Static explanation of why automatic determination is impossible. Never document content.

nodeRef.description: Deterministic node locator: run:<readingOrder>, figure:<pageIndex>:<mcid>, page:<index>, or a document block path like /blocks/3.
